_meta.description: Printer-to-material compatibility matrix. Maps which materials each printer can handle out-of-box, with upgrades, or not at all: a status and the upgrades it needs, for every printer and material. The verdict is public at every tier (it is the upgrade prompt); the sentence explaining it is a curated note served with Kiln Pro. The generic 'default' row keeps its notes, as the floor.
_meta._split_note: Safety-floor profile for AI-controlled FDM printing.  Engineering depth (what to expect from each printer and material together) is available in Kiln Pro; see https://kiln3d.com/pricing.

peek.notes: PEEK cannot run on this printer: needs a 380C hotend, this printer tops out at 240C; needs a 130C bed, this printer tops out at 80C.

pei_1010.notes: PEI 1010 cannot run on this printer: needs a 380C hotend, this printer tops out at 240C; needs an actively heated chamber at 160C, this printer has no heated chamber; needs a 130C bed, this printer tops out at 80C.

pei_9085.notes: PEI 9085 cannot run on this printer: needs a 365C hotend, this printer tops out at 240C; needs an actively heated chamber at 160C, this printer has no heated chamber; needs a 130C bed, this printer tops out at 80C.

pekk.notes: PEKK cannot run on this printer: needs a 350C hotend, this printer tops out at 240C; needs an actively heated chamber at 90C, this printer has no heated chamber.

ppsu.notes: PPSU cannot run on this printer: needs a 390C hotend, this printer tops out at 240C; needs an actively heated chamber at 170C, this printer has no heated chamber; needs a 130C bed, this printer tops out at 80C.

pps.notes: PPS cannot run on this printer: needs a 335C hotend, this printer tops out at 240C; needs a 110C bed, this printer tops out at 80C.

pei_esd.notes: PEI-ESD cannot run on this printer, for the same reason its base polymer cannot: this machine is outside the thermal envelope the material needs.

pekk_esd.notes: PEKK-ESD cannot run on this printer, for the same reason its base polymer cannot: this machine is outside the thermal envelope the material needs.
